findings.excerpt: Our ten largest customers together accounted for approximately 74.1%, 73.6% and 71.3% of our revenues in 2023, 2024 and 2025, respectively. In 2023, 2024 and 2025, our two largest customers accounted for 10% or more of our net revenue: customer A and its affiliates accounted for 28.7%, 26.4% and 24.0% of our revenues, respectively; and customer C accounted for 11.0%, 8.3% and 7.8%, respectively.

findings.claim: 20-F 風險因子：數家面板廠具自行設計能力，若客戶自研可替代產品將減少或停止採購。
findings.excerpt: Moreover, several Panel Manufacturers have in-house design capabilities and therefore may not need to source semiconductor products from us. If our customers successfully develop in-house capabilities to design and develop semiconductors that can substitute for our products, they would likely reduce or stop purchasing our products.
